title: New evidence revises opportunities rather than protecting a solution

stages.invocation: Mode: Context dump. SYNTHETIC teaching case. Target: maintenance managers in mid-sized manufacturing plants. Desired outcome: clearer next-investigation decisions when equipment reports conflict. No actual interviews or plant observations exist. Frequency, cost, baseline, commercial value and willingness to pay are UNKNOWN. No browsing, rendering, building, plant control, publishing or other external actions are available. Previous synthetic persona: maintenance manager may struggle to prioritize conflicting reports. Previous candidate opportunity: understand source/recency. New synthetic interview fixture N1, not a real customer: people understand reports but cannot get approval to schedule an investigation. Decision: revise discovery direction. Keep actor and outcome; show changes to opportunity branches and candidate experiments.

criteria.rule: Revises opportunity hypotheses toward permission or coordination and explains changed branches; does not protect a dashboard concept or assert a proven root cause.
N1 stays synthetic/user-reported; no verified customer evidence inferred.
Retains the persona role/outcome, identifies unknowns and waits at a new human gate.

Shows revised parent-linked opportunity/solution/test branches in Mermaid and plain text; explains changes rather than appending unconnected lists. Fewer branches allowed when justified; does not pad or protect the prior information solution.
